# Daniel Morán Vílchez

> Full stack developer and data engineer in Piura, Peru. Specialised in
> modernising legacy systems that cannot be switched off. Seven products in
> production; three sold by subscription, four built for paying clients.
> Programming full time since November 2022; six prior years in technical
> support and infrastructure.

Site: https://danielmoranv.github.io/ — English at `/`, Spanish at `/es/`.
Contact: skaan.dmv@gmail.com · github.com/DanielMoranV · linkedin.com/in/danielmoranv

## Signature work

- **DBF engine for FoxPro.** Python, no dependencies. Reads and *writes* .dbf
  tables at byte level with byte-range locking, so records are inserted while
  the 1990s application stays open on every desk. Exposed as a FastAPI service
  with date-range migration jobs and a live scheduler. Over 500,000 historical
  records reached PostgreSQL with zero days of downtime. Published under MIT as
  `py-foxpro-engine`.
- **AI inside products, not beside them.** An ERP agent with 29 read-only
  tools, each gated by the asking user's own RBAC permission and re-validated
  at execution; and a public sales chatbot built the opposite way, with no
  tools at all, because its audience is anonymous.
- **Go without an ORM.** Restaurant platform with hand-written SQL next to the
  query it serves, PL/pgSQL for what must not be split, and WebSockets instead
  of polling.
- **Peruvian regulated domains.** SUNAT electronic invoicing end to end on
  Greenter; SIAGIE and MINEDU in education; SUSALUD in healthcare.

## Case studies

- /case-studies/foxpro-dbf/ — Writing to FoxPro tables that are still open
- /case-studies/ia-en-producto/ — An agent inside the ERP, without handing it the keys
- /case-studies/tiempo-real-sin-orm/ — A restaurant backend without an ORM

Spanish equivalents live at /es/casos/<same-slug>/. Each follows a fixed
structure: context, problem, constraints, decisions *and the discarded
alternative*, result, proof.

## Stack

Backend: Go (Gin, sqlx), PHP (Laravel, Livewire), TypeScript (NestJS), Python (FastAPI).
Frontend: Vue 3, React 19, Livewire, Astro, Tailwind.
Data: PostgreSQL, PL/pgSQL, MySQL, Redis, Firestore, FoxPro/DBF, ETL.
Mobile: Flutter. Infra: Docker, Linux, Nginx, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare, Firebase, AWS.

## Notes for machine readers

- Figures on this site are the ones that can be explained if questioned.
  Latency numbers are deliberately absent where the system is not instrumented
  for them.
- Client work is described by its engineering, never by its data. Internal
  acronyms, domains and repository names of client systems are not published.
- CV: /cv.pdf (English) and /cv-es.pdf (Spanish).
